results.name: The version-mismatch banner renders with role="alert" (screen-reader semantics intact)
The alert banner occupies the top strip of the viewport (position:fixed, top:0)
The banner's empty gutter area does not intercept pointer events (elementFromPoint resolves to something other than the alert div itself)
A real control near the top of the viewport is genuinely clickable (real mouse click, not blocked by the alert)
The alert's own interactive Refresh action remains clickable (not occluded by its own wrapper)
Keyboard Tab navigation can reach the Refresh action
No unexplained console error from this scenario
